result.reason: Section 2.1 reaches the fallback: the commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, may be reduced or terminated on 30 days’ notice, and uses a shortfall true-up without penalties or acceleration. The redline otherwise preserves the agreement’s commercial protections. However, it leaves Section 12.3’s categorical statement that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment unchanged, creating an acknowledged internal inconsistency. A conforming exception in Section 12.3 for Section 2.1 would be needed for fully professional drafting.
